utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Absolutely — I can lend a hand and a few tools for the repair drive. Just let me know what you need.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Much appreciated, Gus. I’ll keep an eye out for where they set up the repair drive and let you know if I spot it.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I can help with the repair drive—what still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Mara — keep it low-key, and I can help a little with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—I’ll spread the word about the repair drive at the community center on Sunday and get neighbors involved. If you want, I can also help line up a few volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Quinn—that would be great. Let’s keep it low-key and see if we can get a few volunteers lined up for Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I skimmed the list, but I still need to check what’s left for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry, I’m late again — what’s left on the repair drive list?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: It’s been a nice little flurry—honestly, the table’s getting crowded with donations. You should definitely stop by later; I’m sure they’ll still need a hand.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, I should swing by later and see what’s left to sort. I’ve been a little out of the loop, so just point me at the pile and I’ll help where I can.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I haven’t tracked where it’s set up yet, but I can keep an eye out. If you want, I can also help spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So you’re definitely able to help with the repair drive, right?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Vik — the repair drive is now Sunday at the community center. If you can help line up a few volunteers, that would be wonderful.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Got it — I’ll keep it low-key and let folks know you can help a little with the repair drive. Sunday at the community center, I’ll pass that along.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can check what repair supplies we already have and what we still need for the drive.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great — thanks, Cleo. I’m happy to help once you know what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I’ve only heard bits and pieces—what’s the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Opal — I’ll keep the repair drive low-key and make sure we stay organized.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Sounds good — I’ll keep an eye on where it’s set up and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m happy to help with the repair drive — what details do we have so far?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: We still need to sort out what repairs are left and what supplies we already have. Can you help check the list?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll keep an eye out and let you know if I spot anything we still need.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks—just point me to the remaining tasks when you see them, and I’ll jump in.
